D_ref3_flexcoils.verdict: feasible as 3 FEP-laminated segments per face (polyimide too thin for 5 layers); the end runs add 25 % copper and lift e_ref 2.48 -> 2.64 nV/rtHz: packaging gain (repeatable orientation, REF3T on the same flex), not a weight or noise gain
D_ref3_flexcoils.z_axis: the Z solenoid (3710 turns round the profile) is not a flat coil: stays wound

E_gore_coax.verdict: not adopted: 50 ohm microwave coax; as the TX return it adds about 3 x the strip capacitance (first gate later), and the REF pairs are already guarded in the cord flex; no use found in AXE2

F_metal_core_led.verdict: rejected in the head (a metal core inside the coil is a target); not needed in the pod (LED ring and screen dissipate well under 1 W)
F_metal_core_led.heavy_copper: 17 oz copper is available: an option for the TXD current loop in the chassis (outside the coil field) if its I2R matters

G_ultra_thin.verdict: SHELVED: the 522-LED flex stays at 0.4 mm (head 16.55 mm); the 0.2 mm option would lower the head 0.20 mm, with a +-0.08 mm LED height tolerance in the wells, wider LED power traces on thin copper and stiffeners under the LED pads

H_two_ply_cord.verdict: rejected: stacked, a guarded pair over a TX strip adds about 542 pF/m (the whole strip pair is 30.6 pF/m); offset side by side the plies are 16.9 mm wide, no gain over one ply. Keep one ply with selective copper (2 oz TX / power, 1/2 oz signal): the 0.15 mm traces then meet the 5 x thickness guideline
